{{Youmay|the Human smuggler|the [[Tall (Jenet)|Jenet known as "Tall"]]}}
"'''Tall'''" was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] operating out of [[Tholatin]]. Privy to information on where the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] would attack next, he operated a scam with his partner, "[[Short]]," where he would take paying refugees on their freighter, ''[[Trevee]]'', from refugee settlements to worlds that would soon come under Vong attack. Then, they would swoop in, take the paying customers in again, and continue the scam.
